03 / ACADEMIC PROFILE

Grounded in disaster studies.
Looking through a spatial lens.

I am Kazi Md. Jabed Hossain, a disaster-management graduate from Bangladesh University of Professionals. My interests connect flood risk, coastal environments, remote sensing, and the use of geospatial evidence to understand environmental change.

I am seeking graduate study to deepen my technical skills in geoinformatics and Earth observation, and to build toward research in environmental monitoring and disaster resilience.
